science.clinical_question: Estimate treatment effects using investigator-specified pretreatment variables.

explicit_features.name: age_at_treatment
explicit_features.description: Age at the pretreatment decision point.
explicit_features.measurement_definition: Extract the age in completed years explicitly documented at the pretreatment decision point.
explicit_features.missing_value_rule: Return null if age at the decision point is not documented.

explicit_features.name: ecog_performance_status
explicit_features.measurement_definition: Extract the explicitly documented pretreatment ECOG score. Do not infer a score from symptoms or functional descriptions.
explicit_features.missing_value_rule: Return null if no pretreatment ECOG score is documented.
